question.knowledge_point: Finding Exact Values of Trigonometric Expressions Using the Double-Angle Formula
question.worked_solution:
First, let's recall the double-angle formula for cosine:

$$
1-2{sin}^{2}⁡x=\operatorname{cos}⁡2x
$$

Substituting $x={75}^{∘}$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}1-2{sin}^{2}⁡({75}^{∘}) & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot {75}^{∘}) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡{150}^{∘} \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
